Milkmaid.title: Milkmaid
Milkmaid.description: Jaroslaw Solecki's The Dystopia of an Imitation presents a creative way of exploring the 'matter' of art. The central issue taken up in the work is the sculpting process realised in stone, clay and in the form of digital 3D graphics[...] Quote from the exhibition booklet "The Dystopia of an Imitation"
Milkmaid.author: Jaroslaw Solecki

info_text.text: This exhibit is still in its experimental stage. Some things may change, break, or disappear as we keep testing new ideas. You're welcome to look around, try things out, and see how it evolves. Thanks for being part of the experiment!

metadata.interactionDescription: Click Milkmaid to open the image metadata panel.
Click logo_oficyny to open https://krystynabednarczyk.bluepointart.uk/ in a new browser tab.
